programme.desc: The 2026 Shaw Prize in Life Sciences and Medicine will be awarded equally to Anne Deschamps, Dai Yuge, and Chen Zhu for their discovery of the molecular and cellular pathogenic basis of acute promyelocytic leukemia and for pioneering synergistic targeted therapy, which has transformed this disease from one of the deadliest cancers to one of the most curable cancers, with a cure rate of over 90%.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature (Sr.3)
programme.desc: The "The Joy Of Nature (Sr.3)" embark on another journey, with hosts Maggie Lam,Joey Leung ,Michelle Ip,Verena Wong exploring Jeju Island in South Korea, Hualien in Taiwan, and Taitung in Taiwan, healing their minds and bodies in the embrace of nature. Jeju Island is renowned for its volcanic landscapes and refreshing sea breezes, where the "Nature-Style Beauties" enjoyed natural hot spring spas and immersed themselves in the festive atmosphere of a traditional wildfire festival; they also took speedboats deep into sea caves and off-road vehicles traversing mountains, embarking on an adventurous journey. Moving on to Hualien and Taitung, they discovered hidden gems and exciting activities, including a whale and dolphin hunt at sea; wandering through mountain valleys and enjoying wild hot springs. The team also experienced tribal culture, savoring campfire cuisine; and strolling through a forest "museum" to explore the lives of indigenous people.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Good Morning Hong Kong
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Life On The Line
programme.desc: Ever since his wife CHEUNG WAI-SUM (Ali Lee) was killed by a drunk driver, Principal Ambulanceman MAK CHAY-TIN (Joe Ma) has been living together with his only daughter LOK-YEE, older sister OI-FA (Pinky Cheung) and sister-in-law CHEUNG HO-KEI (Moon Lau). The loss of his wife makes CHAY-TIN hate those rule-breakers and any reckless behaviors. At work, he is stern about everything! His new subordinate CHEUK KA-KIT (Matthew Ho) acts on impulse, and conflict often ensues as a result. Moreover, as a perfectionist, their new superior Probationary Ambulance Officer TAM KA-CHUN (Joey Law) constantly picks on KA-KIT, adding extra pressure to their teammates. Caught in the middle, CHAY-TIN works relentlessly to bridge the differences between them in an effort to promote a spirit of teamwork, cultivating an elite rescue unit to save more lives when facing a variety of challenges……

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Last Breakthrough, The
programme.desc: Dr. WONG PO FUN (CHEUNG KA FAI, NICK) joins “Life Force”, an international medical humanitarian organization, to carry out the unfulfilled wish of his deceased girlfriend, TUNG (LEUNG WING KEI, GIGI). He also sets up “Lung Shing Medical Centre” to help the poor. When FUN is working with the organization in Kenya, he meets a young doctor called CHAI PAK HANG (LAM, RAYMOND), who works at a private hospital named “Ling Siu” in Hong Kong. Influenced by FUN, HANG joins “Lung Shing” later. HONG KIU (KWOK, SONIJA), a nurse at “Ling Siu”, is impressed by FUN by his principle of putting patients first. However, FUN cannot get over TUNG. Meanwhile, HANG meets a volunteer HA HIU CHING (TONG, LEILA) when he is in Africa and likes her very much. When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

When they meet at “Lung Shing” again, CHING hangs back because of the existence of KO SIU YAU (CHAN MAN CHI, SHARON), who comes from a wealthy family. Working with FUN at both “Lung Shing” and “Life Force”, HANG learns that apart from giving patients medical treatments, doctors should also help patients to live a meaningful life. However, when HANG and FUN face their own lifetime challenges, they feel weak and helpless.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Life On The Line
programme.desc: Ever since his wife CHEUNG WAI-SUM (Ali Lee) was killed by a drunk driver, Principal Ambulanceman MAK CHAY-TIN (Joe Ma) has been living together with his only daughter LOK-YEE, older sister OI-FA (Pinky Cheung) and sister-in-law CHEUNG HO-KEI (Moon Lau). The loss of his wife makes CHAY-TIN hate those rule-breakers and any reckless behaviors. At work, he is stern about everything! His new subordinate CHEUK KA-KIT (Matthew Ho) acts on impulse, and conflict often ensues as a result. Moreover, as a perfectionist, their new superior Probationary Ambulance Officer TAM KA-CHUN (Joey Law) constantly picks on KA-KIT, adding extra pressure to their teammates. Caught in the middle, CHAY-TIN works relentlessly to bridge the differences between them in an effort to promote a spirit of teamwork, cultivating an elite rescue unit to save more lives when facing a variety of challenges……

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Outbound Love
programme.desc: In order to develop new business, LAW SIK-SIK (Aimee Chan), who works for a travel agency, goes to Malaysia to have a meeting with her client. Unexpectedly, her plans are ruined by a local cunning tour guide, LUK KUNG-CHI (Ruco Chan), resulting in a falling-out between the two.

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.title: Will Power
programme.desc: At court, two of the most famous lawyers in town YU YING-WAI (Wayne Lai) and LEE MING-YEUNG (Moses Chan) conduct tit-for-tat attacks on each other by any means necessary. YING-WAI eventually turns the tide before he is defeated, however, he almost loses his life in the process, which completely alters his perspective on life. Such change catches a Senior Counsel LO SUM-PO's (Yueh Hua) eye, and he recruits YING-WAI to handle a litigation regarding the will of a late tycoon.

programme.title: Gui Dui
programme.desc: Set during the war against Japanese aggression, the drama follows a small squad from the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army after they lose contact with the main army following a heavy siege by Japanese forces.The story uses a four-line narrative to track the different paths of the scattered soldiers—led by Platoon Leader Lu Changshan and Squad Leader Tang Deyuan—as they navigate various struggles, including labor camps and bandit hideouts. Despite being separated and facing distinct life fates, their ultimate goal remains the same: to survive, fight back, and regroup.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling dreams of becoming a secret agent. Even though it seems impossible, she still harbours such a dream and hopes that it will soon come true. One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a law graduate overwhelmed by despair after failing the bar exam three times and vents his frustration on a drunken passenger one stormy night. Twenty years later, Meng is a successful lawyer, but his investigation into a sexual assault case involving a young girl rekindles haunting memories he cannot escape.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Han Ming, a prosecutor, faces a whirlwind of complications in his work and family lives: his son's clash with another student in school and his wife's intervention, as well as the strained partnerships at work. Amidst it all, a critical case challenges his sense of righteousness, and he decides to gamble everything to seek fairness and justice.

programme.title: Pass and Goal
programme.desc: After a stock crash wipes out everything she has built, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a grassroots kids' football team. Guided by a disabled coach, they prepare to face an elite squad backed by wealthy families. Caught between ambition and conscience, she resolves to use her second half to rewrite the children's first.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung's mad fate?

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: Set in 4 different eras in China, the 4-part anthology about 'home and country' is directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng and Shen Teng, who also star in their own story. The movie depicts how the 'fathers' forge ahead through the struggle of times, defending strong family ties and passing on the 'fighting' spirit through generations.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Xiao Xiao suffers from ADHD and faces bullying in school. Her mother sees her as a troublemaker, while her father toils abroad. The only solace comes from her empathetic teacher, Paul. During a typhoon, Xiao Xiao discovers a secret between her mother and Paul, unravelling complex emotions and shared helplessness in life.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: Hong Kong megastar Lau Wai Chi aspires to win a film award. He teams up with director Lin Hao to make a film about rural China so as to win at the international film festival, and experiences local village life for the farmer's role. This ends up in a series of hilarious events instead.

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Lau's wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Just 1 Day
programme.desc: Mosaic, an urban sketcher, is suffering from ALS and wants to create some fond memories as his condition worsens. When Mosaic reunites with his old classmate Angelfish, whom he has a crush on since primary school, he asks her to fulfill his one last wish by becoming his girlfriend for just one day. Will Angelfish say “yes”?

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Directed by Ann Hui, the movie is adapted from Eileen Chang's first short story. Set in 1930s, Wei Long travels to Hong Kong from Shanghai to pursue her education. Struggling financially, she asks her aunt to help pay for tuition but ends up being her aunt's puppet to lure rich men. When Wei Long falls for playboy, George, she sinks into a life of depravity.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: She’s Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks “Jiang Yuan Nong”. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyone's fate.

programme.title: Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: Set in the 1980s Hong Kong, Elaine and her best friend Ying enter the entertainment industry hoping to change their fates from poverty. Ying soon becomes a popular porn star but Elaine is lost between being her true self and an actress. When show business declines after a decade, their choices lead them to two different paths in life.

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers she's unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora's Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death - a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Big Times For The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again…

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: Young swordsman Shen Bing Yi is appointed leader of the "Sun and Moon" secret society, sworn to take down a traitorous general conspiring with foreign invaders. While fighting for his nation, he captures the hearts of a spirited female warrior and two beautiful Uyghur princesses, leaving him caught between his duty and their devotion.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies…

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Hex vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Tuck Jagadish
programme.desc: Bhudevipuram has a long history of families warring over ancestral property. However, when its headman's family falls into the same trap, his younger son decides to break the village's age-old legacy.

programme.title: Endrendrum Punnagai
programme.desc: Goutham grows up hating women after his mother abandons him during his childhood. Though he decides to stay single while his friends marry, Priya changes his mind about singlehood.

programme.title: Asuraguru
programme.desc: The life of a high-tech robber with exceptional skills of evading the law changes when a private detective tries to get a hold of him.

programme.title: Mapla Singam
programme.desc: Amidst the rivalry of two castes in a village, a leader's daughter falls in love with a boy from the rival caste. Things take a turn when her cousin Anbu falls in love with the boy's sister.

programme.title: V
programme.desc: When aliens land on Earth claiming to help humanity, they seem friendly at first. But as they integrate into society, their hidden agenda starts to unfold.

programme.title: Yaan
programme.desc: Chandru, a jobless man, vows to get a job after the father of his girlfriend opposes their relationship. His joy on getting a job in an Islamic nation ends when he is nabbed there for carrying drugs.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Yaanai
programme.desc: In Ramnad, PRV juggles life with his two wives and kids while facing blame from another family for his brother's death. Tensions rise as their stories intertwine.

programme.title: Kedikkellam Kedi
programme.desc: Sreenu wins Shruthi's love after driving away rival Bhavani, but trouble follows when Rajanna kidnaps her and demands Sreenu marry his daughter, forcing him into a dangerous dilemma.

programme.title: India Pakistan
programme.desc: Two aspiring lawyers, not knowing that both are of the same profession, share the same office. Things take a turn when they work on the same case.

programme.title: Valimai
programme.desc: A city's crime rate rises due to a notorious motorcycle club. When chaos ensues, police officer Arjun takes charge to restore law and order.

programme.title: Bhaskar Oru Rascal
programme.desc: Two kids, each from a single-parent home, team up to bring their moms and dads together, hoping to create the happy, complete family they've always wanted.

programme.title: Kolamaavu Kokila
programme.desc: A young girl in Tamil Nadu turns to the local drug gang to save her dying mother, risking danger, loyalty, and her own future dramatically today.

programme.title: Theeni
programme.desc: Dev, an overweight but genius chef, falls in love with his charming colleague, Tara. However, their love story takes a turn when Maya, a happy-go-lucky woman, enters their lives.

programme.desc: Karate teacher Abhinandan becomes a media sensation after advocating for government takeover of private schools to ensure equal education opportunities, facing threats from school owners.

programme.title: Lakshmi
programme.desc: Lakshmi dreams of winning a national level dance competition but is scared to participate as her mother despises dancing. However, things take a turn when she meets Krishna, a cafe owner.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls in love with a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, however, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

programme.title: Gopal Bhar
programme.desc: Gopal Bhar is appointed as a jester in King Krishnachandra's court. His wit and humour are well-known and his exploits always have a significant social message.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School
programme.desc: Love Potion - The little monsters are in 'POTION CLASS', concocting new and untried potions with professor Burns. Casper accidently tries to brighten things up and ends up with a bright pink potion that put the fear into Prof Burns. Oh NO! Casper's made LOVE POTION, A dreaded, lovely, sweet thing that has no place in Scare School. Casper's told to get rid of it, and throws it away in the Forbidden Forest. But three little dragons drink the potion and turn into pink kissing machines, turning anyone they touch into the same ridiculous chilled out friendly monsters as them. Panic in scare school! The Headmasters are furious and start organising a major hunt for the dragons - until of course but Alder & Dash also turn pink too.. All is almost lost - Casper really must do something: it's OK to have ONE friendly monster but EVERYONE? It's just NOT Scare School! Stage Fright - The Scare School students are getting ready to stage a play, but there's a problem: Dummy Girl has disappeared! Woodward, the figurehead on Cappy's pirate ship, is chosen to replace her. Unfortunately he really is a 'wooden' actor, and it's a total disaster. The audience, who was supposed to be frightened, starts laughing. What a catastrophe for the kids of Scare School! What will the parents think? Will they take their kids out of school? How will Casper and his friends make it through? The answer is in this very special episode in which you can watch the play in real time!

programme.desc: Arisu attends the weekly school live event to assess Rikka's true ability after she rejects the goal he set for her. When she begins singing, her voice overlaps with the voice of Apollo.

programme.desc: Raku and Chitoge visit a restaurant where Marika works. A fight breaks out and she throws them out. Raku's friends visit him on New Year's. Chaos ensues when they mistakenly eat chocolates with whiskey.

programme.title: NISEKOI OVA Ep03
programme.desc: Raku visits a public bathhouse where he meets Chitoge and Marika. The girls visit a mountain hot spring, while Raku and Shu head to the men's hot spring on the other side of the mountain.

programme.title: NISEKOI: S2 Ep01
programme.desc: To end the war between Shueigumi and the Beehive Gang, Raku and Chitoge must fake being a couple. Chitoge realizes her feelings for Raku. What will become of their fake relationship?

programme.title: NISEKOI: S2 Ep02
programme.desc: Seishiro attends high school with Chitoge to protect her. As she's about to leave school, she suddenly comes under fire. Raku is dragged into Seishiro and Paula's feud. Can Raku escape safely?

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep10
programme.desc: Two years ago, Paradis welcomed their first visitor who was surprised to see one of their own. Obtaining their help will be critical in a three-part plan to protect Paradis.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep11
programme.desc: Trapped on the world's most dangerous island, Falco and Gabi will do anything to survive. Elsewhere, the public demands answers when they learn the savior of Paradis has been detained.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep12
programme.desc: While Hange and Pyxis piece together Zeke's true intentions, tension builds outside HQ where Armin and Mikasa plead for permission to speak with Eren.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep13
programme.desc: Gabi and Falco seek out a fellow Marleyan who's surprised to see Warrior candidates. The truth of what happened at Ragako may shed some light on Zeke's secret plans.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep09
programme.desc: Zagan and Barbatos meets Raphael, the fearsome Holy Sword wielder, and learns about Chastille's punishment. Back at the castle, Barbatos arrives with Chastille, who has been poisoned.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep10
programme.desc: Foll departs for the Archdemon Hall, seeking new power for her revenge. She confronts Raphael, who has been following her, and realizes the connection between him and her murdered father.

programme.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke up Piloting the Strongest Starship! Ep06
programme.desc: Takahiro 'Hiro' is reborn into his favourite game, commanding the best starship. He journeys across space as a mercenary to fulfil his dream of buying an expensive house with a garden.

programme.desc: Makoto and his classmates are transported to another world, but he is the only weak one. Pairing up with a forgotten goddess, Noah, Makoto aims for the top using unorthodox methods, hardcore mode!

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep07
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep08
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: S2 Ep11
programme.desc: Chise learns that Lucy and Simeon are unconscious as a result of mana loss caused by 'The Testament of Carnamagos'. Chise accepts Elias' help to save the two of them, but...

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: S2 Ep12
programme.desc: On behalf of Lucy, Chise and friends visit the Waste Disposal Facility, where they encounter a suspicious man, Zaccheroni. Following his lead, they step into the basement of the facility...

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep11
programme.desc: Ichikawa's family is in Akita. While taking pictures of the scenery, Ichikawa falls and fractures his arm. Ichikawa informs Yamada of the incident and receives a video call from Yamada...

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep12
programme.desc: Ichikawa and family bump into Yamada at the shrine. Kana invites Yamada over to their house. Sensing the chemistry between her beloved younger brother and Yamada, Kana decides to play cupid.

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep01
programme.desc: Saito Hojo hates his classmate, Akane Sakuramori. Yet, the two are forced to get married by their grandparents. Thus begins the newlywed life of the two rivals under one roof...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep02
programme.desc: Saito and Akane's newlywed life is full of conflicts. Saito reaches out to Shisei, while Akane consults Himari. As they explore ways to live together more comfortably, they grow closer...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep03
programme.desc: Saito and Akane finally grow closer, but struggle to keep their marriage under wraps. Later, Akane pulls all-nighters studying for tests, but ends up catching a cold...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep04
programme.desc: Akane causes a ruckus after finding a ghost(?) at home. Saito asks Shisei for help as Shisei ends up staying over. Akane starts feeling uneasy over the closeness between Saito and Shisei...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep05
programme.desc: Himari tells Akane that she likes Saito and asks for her support. Himari and Saito get closer as Akane begin to have mixed feelings. Later, Himari visits Akane at home while Saito hides.

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep06
programme.desc: Himari suggests a group study session with Saito, Akane and Shisei, while Saito and Akane work hard to keep their secret. Later, Saito notices Akane feeling down and asks her on a date.

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep07
programme.desc: Saito asks his aunt, Reiko, for a part-time job in secret to buy Akane the ring she wants. Akane learns that Saito has been visiting Shisei's, but Reiko coldly brushes her off when she asks...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep08
programme.desc: Maho, a mysterious transfer student, confesses to Saito. She knows that he stays with Akane and asks him to show her around town. On their way back, Maho decides to follow Saito home...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep09
programme.desc: When visiting an amusement park, Saito learns that Maho used to be a sickly child. Despite his worry, Maho pretends to collapse, angering Saito. At night, Akane catches Maho in Saito's room...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep10
programme.desc: Saito and Akane's classmates learn about their secret. To stop rumors from spreading, Himari pretends to date Saito. However, the 'fake girlfriend' plan escalates beyond a pretense...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep11
programme.desc: Saito and Akane exchange contacts. Saito attends a family banquet while Akane and Himari bake sweets at home. Seeing Himari and Saito in close contact, just like lovers, Akane feels down...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep12
programme.desc: Akane recalls the first time she met Saito-the memory of a first love before they knew each other. After an incident, Himari makes a move on Saito and a photo of them spreads in class...

programme.desc: A man has many failed suicide attempts. After the most recent one, he discovers he can see a family of ghosts. The ghosts agree to leave him alone under the condition that he fulfill their requests.

programme.title: Single in Seoul
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho is a famous influencer who praises living a single life. Hyeon-Jin is an editor who is desperate about finding her partner. The two meets while working together for a book.

programme.title: I, the Executioner
programme.desc: Detective Seo Do-Cheol and rookie cop Park Sun-Woo investigate a murder which reveals links to past cases of a serial killer. The killer releases a teaser online and intesifies the chaos.

programme.title: Confession (2014)

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Su-young gets entangled in corruption and takes the blame for a reward. After her release, she finds Andy who promised her the reward but faces a bigger force behind him.

programme.title: In Our Prime

programme.title: Nocturnal
programme.desc: After his brother Seok-tae returns as a bloody corpse, Min-tae discovers the death of his brother was foretold in a novel, and Seok-tae's wife had a suspicious call with the novelist...

programme.title: Veteran
programme.desc: A merciless detective hunts down a young and successful drug addict who always escapes from investigations with the help of his wealth and connections.

programme.title: The King's Warden

programme.title: My Puppy
programme.desc: A groom-to-be sets off with his friend to finding a new owner for his puppy.

programme.title: Devils
programme.desc: Jae-hwan is a detective catching the serial murderer Jin-hyeok and they have a physical struggle. When Jae-hwan wakes up in the hospital, he realized their bodies have been switched...

programme.title: Fist & Furious
programme.desc: A former detective grants permission to a freelance video journalist to cover his revenge journey on a mob boss whom previously killed his partner during an investigation.

programme.title: The Ghost Game

programme.title: The Old Woman With the Knife

programme.title: Hi-five

programme.title: Africa Live
programme.desc: Africa Live is a news program that focuses on African issues and issues related to this diverse continent. CGTN’s Nairobi-based broadcast center produces Africa Live. Local correspondents and local production teams provide authoritative and in-depth stories from across the region. Africa Live is an objective and comprehensive look at every facet of African life.

programme.title: Asia Today
programme.desc: Asia Today highlights the latest news and social developments across Asia. Correspondents in over a dozen countries report on the region’s top stories as they happen. Analysts bring Asian perspective to topical and developing issues. Asia Today also emphasizes the diverse cultures and lifestyles of the world’s most populous continent.

The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: The Monster Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so... with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that's what she's supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

programme.title: The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggee's cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There's a big match ahead...

programme.title: Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Stick Time
programme.desc: How many siblings does Norrie have? What's Duggee's favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

programme.desc: Water, water, everywhere - there's a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.

programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, there's a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

programme.title: Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Cold
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-­Laa and Po are outside in the cold when they spot the Tiddlytubbies who are warm, inside. The Teletubbies put on hats, gloves and scarves to keep warm.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like you've never seen them before!

programme.title: Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Cubby

programme.title: Lorenzo's Solo

programme.title: Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Max and Monty's antics on a construction site get them into trouble when they ignore the danger warning signs.

programme.title: Funky Fireflies, Selangor River, Malaysia
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are paddling down Malaysia's Selangor River in canoes to look at the region's fireflies. But after a bend in the river, they encounter Glitch attempting to chop down one of the protected mangrove trees, hoping to impress Tala with the rare plant. Although they manage to stop him, the approaching dark and some thick mud leave them in a tricky situation. Can the team work out how to light their way and find their friends?

programme.title: Pirate Peril, Jamaica
programme.desc: While Xuli and Lars help some local divers explore the underwater ruins of Port Royal, Jamaica, Glitch sets off in search of treasure buried by his great-great-great-uncle, Captain Grimbeard. programme.title: TAJWID CINTA
programme.desc: Dafri plans to return to Indonesia to meet Alina and get engaged, but his plans are disrupted when Syifa's wedding falls apart after her fiancé, Ilham, disappears. Dafri is eventually arranged to marry Syifa, whom he has only just met, because his father owes Syifa's parents a debt of gratitude. Their arranged marriage leads to a series of conflicts.

programme.title: Gak Bisa Yura Mbaknya Galak Banget
programme.desc: Yura (Djihan Ranti) is a beautiful young office worker who accidentally meets Guntur (Masaji Wijayanto), a man looking for a job. An incident leads to Guntur being hired as Yura's personal driver. From their first meeting, Yura is annoyed with him, and he ends up disrupting her work.

programme.title: RODA - RODA GILA
programme.desc: Roda-Roda Gila follows Elvano, a motorcycle enthusiast, and his romantic journey with Mika, the daughter of a veteran racer. Elvano falls for Mika when they first meet at a racing circuit, but their relationship faces opposition from their respective parents and friends.

programme.title: GARIS CINTA
programme.desc: Garis Cinta follows two sisters, Citra and Bunga, who were separated as babies after their family was involved in an accident and were raised by different families. Eighteen years later, they grow up in very different family circumstances and meet at the same university, where they both fall in love with a man named Reyhan.

programme.title: MARTABAK NO.32 SPESIAL ANTI GAGAL
programme.desc: Adit and Nayla meet at a market and seem to dislike each other because of Nayla's actions toward Adit. However, they grow closer when they start a martabak business together, and gradually fall in love without realizing it.

programme.title: Balance of Power
programme.desc: Bloomberg Balance of Power focuses on politics and policies on Capitol Hill, in President Trump's administration, the federal agencies and the courts.

programme.title: Bloomberg BusinessWeek
programme.desc: Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec bring together the latest news from the world of business and finance by harnessing the power of Bloomberg Businessweek reporters and editors.

programme.title: How China Plans to Turn Its Factories Green
programme.desc: The zero-carbon industrial park is one of China’s recent tactics to decarbonize its factories through renewable power. Can its nascent technology move China into a greener era of mass production?

programme.title: Can Microbes Solve the Copper Problem?
programme.desc: The global copper supply is on a collision course with growing electricity demand. Now some companies are turning to biomining, the process of using microbes to extract metals, to boost supply.

programme.title: Inside a Giant Electric Ferry
programme.desc: While electric vehicles have gone mainstream, shipping has lagged behind. But now, the humble passenger ferry may be the most primed to make battery-powered boats a viable option.

programme.title: AI Is Pushing Chipmaking to Its Limits
programme.desc: Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices. Now, global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.

programme.title: The Race to Fuel a Nuclear Energy Comeback
programme.desc: Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex. From mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?

programme.title: Anthropic Co-Founders Dario and Daniela Amodei (Part 1)
programme.desc: Anthropic Co-Founders Dario and Daniela Amodei (Part 1). Emily meets Anthropic co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei for a rare, in-depth discussion of the startup's origin story.

programme.title: Anthropic Co-Founders Dario and Daniela Amodei (Part 2)
programme.desc: A Bloomberg Originals series hosted by Emily Chang that goes behind the scenes with founders, influencers and innovators.

programme.title: Netflix (Part 1)
programme.desc: Emily Chang travels to Paris, Seoul and Los Angeles to explore Netflix's next chapter in the entertainment world.

programme.title: Inside America's Prediction Market Boom
programme.desc: Emily Chang hits the streets of New York with Tarek Mansour, who along with Luana Lopes Lara created Kalshi, the biggest prediction market in the world.

programme.title: The Rise and Reckoning of Jensen Huang
programme.desc: An inside look at Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang just weeks before he revealed an extramarital affair with a woman the US reportedly suspects to be a Chinese spy.

programme.title: Netflix (Part 1)
programme.desc: Emily Chang travels to Paris, Seoul and Los Angeles to explore Netflix's next chapter in the entertainment world.

programme.title: Waymo's Bet on a Driverless Future
programme.desc: Emily Chang travels to San Francisco to meet Tekedra Mawakana, Waymo’s co-CEO. Chang asks Mawakana how a career overseeing technological pivots.

programme.title: Artificial Intelligence Pioneer Fei-Fei Li

programme.title: Con Girl / No Fun Run
programme.desc: After complaining to a waiter about finding a hair in her food, Lola realizes she can con her way into getting free perks. // To avoid Coach Keck's weekly runs, Lincoln and his friends face off against the faculty in physical fitness challenges.

programme.title: Coupe Dreams
programme.desc: In order to buy her dream car, Lori becomes a local rideshare driver.

programme.title: Hiccups and Downs / The Loathe Boat
programme.desc: Luna needs to get rid of a nasty case of the hiccups before a big rock competition. // The Morticians Club plan Bertrand's escape from the cruise ship his parents work on.

programme.title: Earth Day Games
programme.desc: The Twins really want to win the Earth Day Games at school.

programme.title: Rosa is fired
programme.desc: Rosa's fired by the Mayor when she arrives with her mother to utter chaos and mess.

programme.title: Wiener Takes All / Stuck in an Elevator
programme.desc: Tired of doing grunt work at the Krusty Krab, Squidward takes a new job as Manager of Weenie Hut Jr's. // Squidward gets trapped in an elevator with SpongeBob and Patrick on his way to return a nearly overdue library book.

programme.title: Safety Worst / De-Pat-ment Store
programme.desc: After yet another Star house disaster, the fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video. // Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall.

programme.title: Who's Afraid of Mr. Snippers? / A Fish Called Sandy
programme.desc: Squidward and Plankton take to the stage to take down a common adversary. // To experience the ocean firsthand, Sandy swaps genes with a fish.

programme.title: Food Con Castaways
programme.desc: The gang heads to a food convention, but things go awry when they become stranded in the woods.

programme.title: Grouse of Horrors / The Lynning Ticket
programme.desc: Grouse pulls out all the stops to drive Lance and his family out of Royal Woods after they move next door. // After launching an online sports show, Lynn quickly learns which tactics will generate clicks and grow her fanbase.

programme.title: Prom-Com / Scene Steeler
programme.desc: When Leni is put in charge of the school's prom, she is determined to make it the most memorable night ever. // Lincoln and Clyde cast Luan as the villain, Bee Trayal, in their David Steele film and have to deal with her method acting.

programme.title: Driver's Dread
programme.desc: Hoping to drive out to the outlets to meet Lori, Leni ooks for alternative ways to get her driver's license.

programme.title: Bringing Down the House House
programme.desc: Lay Lay and Sadie volunteer to build houses for those in need, but when Sadie is put in charge of all the workers, managing Lay Lay becomes her biggest challenge.

programme.title: Cherry Bad Things
programme.desc: Cherry visits, and the Thundermans discover she still has her superpowers. Cherry promises to remove them after her girls' day with Phoebe and Chloe, but the powers malfunction and puts the group in danger. Max hosts Jinx, making Colosso jealous.

programme.title: JAM Session
programme.desc: When Ray hears that Piper is going to Junior Anger Management to work on her anger issues, he makes a wager with Henry that he can make her lose her temper before the night ends.

programme.title: Green Fingers
programme.desc: After Schwoz creates a disease that accidentally effects Charlotte, Henry, his family, and even Ray, he quarantines them in Henry's house in order to find a cure.

programme.title: Let's Go to the Movies!
programme.desc: ShoutOut has a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to sell a movie to Hollywood bigshot Deuce Van Nuys, but when her mind goes blank under the pressure, the rest of Danger Force pitch in and share their own epic--and epically bad--movie ideas.

programme.title: iKiss
programme.desc: Sam overhears Freddie confess to Carly that he's never kissed a girl, then exposes his secret on the webshow. Gibby and Carly train Spencer for a tryout with the local professional football team.

programme.title: iGive Away a Car
programme.desc: The gang runs a contest on iCarly -- the prize is a new car courtesy of a local dealership. After Nevel wins, the kids discover that the dealership had no knowledge of the contest or the free car they were supposedly donating.

programme.title: Robarazzi
programme.desc: Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop. Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.

programme.title: #BabysittingCommercial
programme.desc: To boost their babysitting business, Sam and Cat make a commercial that features Dice's beloved dog. A family recognizes the dog and seeks legal ownership, claiming the dog belongs to them.

programme.title: The Rejects
programme.desc: When Leo, Mikey, and Raph are captured by the mad scientist Jordan Perry and his Monster Mutanimals, Donnie must stop a mutant invasion on Staten Island and save everyone from the terrifying creation known as Mutant Omega!

programme.title: Rise of the Night Ninja
programme.desc: When Leo accidentally saves a subway station full of innocent people, he's inspired to take on a life of crime-fighting vigilantism as the Night Ninja! But has he met his match with the villainous La Fleur and her gang of dognappers?

programme.title: License to Milkshake / Squid Baby
programme.desc: SpongeBob learns his milkshake license has expired, and is forced to go back to the milkshake academy. // Squidward hits his head and reverts to being a baby, and it's up to SpongeBob and Patrick to take care of him.

programme.title: Little Yellow Book / Bumper to Bumper
programme.desc: Squidward finds SpongeBob's diary, and starts reading it out loud in the Krusty Krab. // SpongeBob once again fails his driving test, forcing Mrs. Puff to think outside the box--and off the road.

programme.title: Eek, An Urchin! / Squid's Defense
programme.desc: SpongeBob finds a nasty sea urchin living in the Krusty Krab, and tries everything to force it out. // After getting his groceries stolen, Squidward convinces SpongeBob and Sandy to teach him karate.

programme.title: Snapshot slip up! / The Park Beast
programme.desc: The Marsups are photographed by a street mapper car, so the twins must find a way to delete the photos! // Rosa thinks there's a Beast loose in the park, when she catches a glimpse of the Marsups.

programme.title: Twins in Charge / Sticky tails

programme.title: In a Space Pickle / Stare Wars
programme.desc: Quasar uses Patrick to communicate with the dumbest aliens in the universe. // Patrick and GrandPat have a staring contest to compete for the last lick of a baking spoon.

programme.title: Safety Worst / De-Pat-ment Store
programme.desc: After yet another Star house disaster, the fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video. // Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall.

programme.title: For Your Spies Only
programme.desc: Max and Phoebe attend Parent-Teacher Night, leaving Chloe and friends home without adult supervision. When Jinx finds the Air Lair, he believes spies are targeting the school, and his meddling puts the Thundermans' school jobs at risk.

programme.title: Let's Go to the Movies!

programme.title: Suite and Sour / Back in Black
programme.desc: After Mom and Dad win a trip to a resort, they decide to take the kids - but only because they promised to behave. // When Lucy gets a crush on a 'regular and normal' boy, her sisters give her a makeover.

programme.title: Making the Grade / Vantastic Voyage

programme.title: Doodle Dimension / Moving Bubble Bass

programme.title: High Sea Diving / Bottle Burglars

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao inadvertently enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi, whilst covertly serving rebels seeking the sacred “Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters”. Caught between rival factions when the Emperor seeks it too, Xiao Bao must rely on his quick wit and cunning to survive the perilous court and evade danger.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Vengeance is a Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter. Li and his daughter manage to escape and the latter grows up to be a skilled swordswoman who vows to avenge her mother's death-a lie told by Li. The truth is revealed when she sees her mother alive by chance.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket

programme.title: The Merry Wife

When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Knight of Knights

Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond

programme.title: The Duel of the Century

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears

programme.title: Tragic Commitment

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web

programme.title: Stuff / Campout

programme.title: Family Trip / Great Great Grandicorn
programme.desc: Kelp and Scallop help Dad discover the true meaning of family trips. / When the Great Great Grandicorn comes to visit, the kids learn that making mistakes is part of learning.

programme.title: Crash Course
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: Furious Fun
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders have a "Dragon Day" to show their skills to a young fan, but Aggro skips it to hang out with her new fun -- but reckless -- friends.

programme.title: The Fairy Festival!
programme.desc: Kitty Fairy's garden is transformed into a fairy-riffic fairground for The Fairy Festival! At the festival, Gabby and Pandy meet an excitable little fairy named Luli-loo who joins them as they explore the festival. Luli-loo may not be the best at all the fair games, but she's never afraid to give it a go and learn from her mistakes!

programme.title: Dollhouse Fairy Tales
programme.desc: The Gabby Cats put their own spin on the classic fairytales "Rapunzel," "The Princess and the Pea," and "Little Red Riding Hood." For the Cat of the Day Segment, CatRat sings a song!

programme.title: CupKate

While on a no-holds barred quest to get Kate her favorite cupcakes, Melman learns the gift doesn’t matter, as long as it comes from the heart.

programme.title: Pest Side Story
programme.desc: Gloria becomes determined to earn her Queen of Kindness Kidizen badge and welcomes some free-spirited rats who need a place to stay into the habitat. Despite her discomfort, Gloria encourages the rats to make themselves at home. When the rats play with her special baby tusk at the bottom of her tank, she finally snaps and sends the rats home. It isn't until the gang winds up at the rats' nest and Gloria almost takes a slice of the rats special cheese that she learns it's okay to say no.

programme.title: Something Old, Something New / The Ghoster
programme.desc: Archibald stumbles into playing the part of a wedding planner as he attempts to help a frazzled groom pull off the perfect day. / Archibald unknowingly buys a haunted toaster and summons a ghost by mistake.

programme.title: Moosebumps!: Chapter Two

programme.title: Moosebumps!: Chapter Three
programme.desc: Bullwinkle and Rocky fly to a mysterious monster-inhabited island to meet the missing mad scientist that created the serum that turned Bullwinkle into a monster, only to learn of the biggest, meanest monster on the island, Humongalon

programme.title: Sitting On Babies / Best Frenemies
programme.desc: Things go very wrong when Tip and Oh watch the Gorg babies at a cheese-themed playland/Captain Smek pretends to be Oh's friend just to ruin his day.

programme.title: The Beast
programme.desc: Po and team play a game of Pok-ta-pok against a family of armadillos for the opportunity to talk one on one with Zuma, the leader. The game brings out a highly competitive and aggressive side to Blade, known as "The Beast." Back in China, Colin and Weimin find the Pirate Queen and become part of her pirate crew.

programme.title: An Uphill Battle
programme.desc: The Dragon Knights make a deal for the Storm Wheel but first must obtain the other Storm Wheel from a mysterious mad scientist. Though Mastodon continues to warn the team about the dangers in using the Tianshang Weapons, they use them in a fight against Klaus and Veruca. The clash of the weapons wakes a dormant volcano!

programme.title: The Mad Scientist
programme.desc: The Mad Scientist turns out to be an ally called Akna, who has a history with Blade's brother Alfie. And Blade learns another truth about her brother and his mission. And in the course of a skirmish with Klaus and Veruca, the weapons change hands again.

programme.title: Game Of Crows
programme.desc: The Croods and Bettermans take in Malachi, Gran's longtime enemy, until his broken wing heals. Eep is unsure whether or not Malachi can be trusted.

programme.title: Pie Hard

programme.title: Snack of Dawn
programme.desc: Dawn is bummed when an injury prevents her from joining the Croods and Bettermans to a trip to Fizzy Falls, but when Thunk recruits her on his quest for an ancient stash of legendary snacks, Dawn can't resist joining the treasure hunt.

programme.title: Incineration Day

But when a mysterious figure steals the warehouse full of to be destroyed spy tech, the team heads to Europe to embark on their most dangerous mission yet.

programme.title: Snowed In
programme.desc: The team uncovers the person behind the Incineration Day theft: General Dudley! While tracking him down, they’re led into an ambush in the Swiss Alps. Is the general just a pawn in a larger plan?

programme.title: Rafaela’s Raf-venge
programme.desc: The team realizes that they’re being led on a wild goose chase and that the person behind it all must be the one and only Rafaela! She’s broken out of prison and is now causing havoc in Berlin using the dangerous stolen spy tech – which makes her more formidable that ever before.

programme.title: Something Rotten On Beserker Island
